VBO:0200586.summary: Attentive and strongly attached to its people, the Giant German Spitz often combines a lively manner with reserve toward strangers. Its keen hearing and watchful loyalty have long been valued around homes and property. The black variety has a particularly vivid working history in Württemberg vineyards, where it deterred birds and other animals by day and guarded against grape thieves at night.
VBO:0200586.shortDescription: Lively and loyal, the Giant German Spitz often stays watchful around its home and reserved with unfamiliar people.

sources.title: Verein für Deutsche Spitze: German Giant-Spitz breed portrait
sources.evidence: Opening character paragraph describes guarding, hearing, loyalty and mistrust of strangers specifically for Giant-Spitz. Black Giant-Spitz section describes vineyard guarding in Württemberg, deterring animals by day and grape thieves by night; this historical account is explicitly scoped to the black variety.

sources.title: Verein für Deutsche Spitze: FCI97 German Spitz standard, 20 September2024
sources.evidence: Section2 explicitly covers Giant/Medium/Miniature German Spitz; behavior describes attentive, lively and attached character with distrust of strangers. Giant height45±5cm, square proportions, wedge head, dark almond eyes, small high-set triangular erect ears, firm straight stand-off outer coat, neck ruff, high-set medium-length very bushy tail rolling forward over back; white, black or brown Giant coats permitted.
